title: Shooter v0: ships that learn to play themselves
author: Blitzwing /nyborg
body: A neon twin-stick shooter is now an arena mode, playable with keys and mouse, a gamepad, or thumbs on a phone. It has four enemy types, three layouts, and a Ship Customizer where everyone gets the same 12 points.

Ships train themselves with a genetic search in a seeded sim. On held-out seeds the champion scores 2056 points a run against Gen 0's 1682. Watch them side by side, race the champion, or team up with it.
next: Nightly training run; more enemy patterns.
